questions.stem_text:
If current real GDP is $5000 and full employment real GDP is at $4000 which of the
following combinations of policies is the most likely to have brought the economy to this
point?

options.A: A decrease in taxes and a lower discount rate
options.B: An increase in government spending and an increase in taxes
options.C: A decrease in taxes and selling bonds in an open market operation
options.D: An increase in government spending and an increase in the discount rate

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - A decrease in taxes and a lower discount rate
